description: Rumble keyword search — same video card shape as channel-videos (type, durationSeconds + durationText, UTC publishedAt). Costs ~12 credits (0.6/result). Empty results and failures are never charged. Pass cache=true for a free 24h cache hit (default always fresh).

cache.description: Set true to serve from the 24h response cache (0 credits on hit). Default false — always fetch fresh. Envelope includes cached + cachedAt on hits.

limit.description: Max items to return (default 20, max 200). Billed per result.

name: rumble_search
title: Rumble Search
